infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Easy Surfaces uses the camera to scan slab tags, receipts and business cards, and to take photos for visits, resources and deliveries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose photos and PDFs to attach to visits, resources and receipts.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Easy Surfaces uses Face ID to sign you in quickly and securely.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Easy Surfaces to use your location during work hours to record Visits and Resources, and to schedule your day.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Choose Always Allow so Easy Surfaces can record your Visits and Resources and plan your day. Without it, some features won’t work.
